# 大品經遊意

**ID:** T1696
**Volume:** T33
**Category:** 般若部類
**Original Category:** 經疏部
**Byline:** 隋 吉藏撰
**Dynasty:** 隋
**Date:** 549–623

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle Suí-period programmatic commentary by Jízàng 吉藏 (549–623) on Kumārajīva's *[Móhē bōrě bōluómì jīng (T223)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0004)* — the *Pañcaviṃśatisāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā*. The *yóuyì* 遊意 ("wandering-meaning" / programmatic prefatorial exposition) genre is one of Jízàng's signature commentarial forms, presenting the *prajñāpāramitā*-doctrine in its broadest doctrinal sweep before the line-by-line exegesis of the longer commentary.

**Abstract**

T1696 is one of three Jízàng commentaries on T223 included in the canon ([T1696](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0007), [X451](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0009), and [T1697](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0008) — the last by [元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89) Wǒnhyo, not Jízàng — see entries). The single-fascicle *yóuyì* form gives the doctrinal-philosophical core of Jízàng's reading of the *Prajñāpāramitā*; the longer *[Dàpǐn jīng yìshū (X451)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0009)* gives the line-by-line commentary. The work is dateable to Jízàng's documented active commentarial period, c. 580–623 CE. T1696 is one of the principal sources for the formation of Sānlùn / Mādhyamika *prajñā*-doctrine as a Chinese philosophical system.
